login.title: Sign in to Procrastibaker
login.intro: Create an account or sign in to start baking. Your bakery, pastries, coins, and streak are saved to your account and synced across your devices.
login.legalPrefix: By continuing you agree to our

validation.passwordRequirements: At least 8 characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, and a number.
validation.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters long.
validation.passwordLowercase: Password must include a lowercase letter.
validation.passwordUppercase: Password must include an uppercase letter.
validation.usernameTooShort: Username must be at least 2 characters.
validation.usernameTooLong: Username must be 32 characters or fewer.
validation.usernameInvalid: Username can only contain letters and numbers — no spaces or symbols.

dashboard.heroBody: Start a focused baking session, keep your pastry warm, and grow your study shelf one completed block at a time.
dashboard.selectedPastryReady: {{name}} is ready for your next baking session.
dashboard.usernameHelp: Update the name shown around your study bakery. Letters and numbers only.
dashboard.usernamePattern: Letters and numbers only — no spaces or symbols.
dashboard.nudgeStart: Finish a bake today to start your streak.
dashboard.nudgeSafe: You've baked today — your streak is safe. 🔥
dashboard.nudgeKeep: Bake today to keep your {{count}}-day streak alive. 🔥
dashboard.nudgeFreeze: Bake today and a streak freeze will save your run.
dashboard.nudgeCooled: Your streak cooled off — finish a bake today to start a fresh one.

timer.prepareBody: Choose a duration, study tag, and unlocked pastry. The countdown starts when you begin baking.
timer.selectedForLine: Selected for {{minutes}} minutes of {{tag}}. Complete it to earn {{reward}}.
timer.readyMsg: Timer complete. Your pastry is ready to leave the oven.
timer.successMsg: Session saved. Returning to your dashboard.
timer.pausedMsg: Timer paused. Resume when you are ready to keep baking.
timer.expiredMsg: This pastry expired because the session was stopped early.
timer.finishHelpWaiting: Finish Session becomes available when the countdown reaches zero.
timer.confirmCancelMsg: If you stop now, this pastry will expire and move to your expired pastry bin. You will not earn coins for this session.
timer.blockerMsg: Your pastry is still baking. If you leave now, it will expire and go to the bin.
timer.audioHelp: Oven ambience plays only during an active study session.

shop.title: Pastry shop
shop.intro: Spend study coins on new pastries, then choose one as your active bake for future focus sessions.
shop.freezeDesc: Protects your streak from one missed day. Hold up to {{max}}.

pastryCard.unlockHint: Complete more study sessions to unlock this pastry.

sessionCard.expiredCopy: This pastry expired because the session was stopped early. Try finishing your next baking session.

bakery.title: Bakery shelf
bakery.intro: Your completed study pastries are arranged by type, with stopped sessions kept in the expired bin below.
bakery.emptyTitle: You have not baked any pastries yet.
bakery.emptyBody: Start a study session to fill your bakery.
bakery.expiredEmpty: No expired pastries yet. Keep your next bake going until the timer finishes.

stats.title: Study stats
stats.intro: A clear breakdown of completed focus time, stopped sessions, pastry bakes, and study tag patterns.
stats.emptyBody: Complete or cancel a baking session to start filling your stats.
stats.donutEmpty: No study time logged yet. Finish a bake to fill the wheel.

heatmap.aria: Focus calendar. {{days}} active days, {{time}} focused in total.
heatmap.shareError: Couldn't create the image. Please try again.

weeklyTrend.empty: No focus logged in the last {{weeks}} weeks yet. Finish a bake to start the trend.
weeklyTrend.barsAria: Weekly focus for the last {{weeks}} weeks. Busiest week {{time}}.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.intro: Spotted a bug, got a UI gripe, or have an idea to make the bakery better? Pick a category and tell us what is on your mind.
feedback.successBody: Your note is on its way to the Procrastibaker kitchen.
feedback.placeholder: What happened, or what would make Procrastibaker better?
feedback.errorGeneric: Something went wrong while sending your feedback. Please try again.
feedback.errorNetwork: Could not reach the feedback service. Check your connection and try again.

account.title: Account & Privacy
account.intro: Manage your data and privacy choices. You can export or delete everything we store about you at any time.
account.exportBody: Download a copy of your profile, study sessions, and tags as a JSON file (GDPR data portability).
account.exportError: We couldn't build your export. Please try again.
account.resetEmailPrefix: We'll email you a secure link to set a new password for
account.googlePasswordNote: You sign in with Google, so your password is managed in your Google account settings.
account.analyticsToggle: Opt out of anonymous product analytics. We use privacy-friendly, cookieless analytics to understand which features are used — turn it off here and we'll stop collecting it on this device.
account.deleteBody: Permanently delete your account and all associated data — your profile, study sessions, tags, coins, and streak. This cannot be undone.
account.googleReconfirm: You'll be asked to re-confirm with Google before your account is deleted.
account.passwordRequired: Please enter your password to confirm.
